headlines.title: How Small Pharmacy Expansion Will Impact CVS Health (CVS) Investors
headlines.summary: CVS Health has been rolling out smaller pharmacy focused stores, expanding MinuteClinic sites and raising its 2026 revenue and earnings outlook, alongside new efforts in benefit transparency and women’s midlife health research. The push into underserved neighborhoods with compact pharmacies and clinics points to a tighter focus on access, operating efficiency and aligning physical sites with where prescription demand actually shows up.

headlines.title: CVS Health (CVS) Opens New Pharmacy Focused Locations
headlines.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) has introduced new pharmacy-focused store formats aimed at expanding local access to pharmacy care in select communities. The business is working with The Midlife Collective on a research study examining women's midlife health experiences, paired with a future documentary. The collaboration is expected to explore cultural narratives around midlife health for women and how support systems respond to their needs.

headlines.title: CVS targets former Walgreens, Rite Aid customers after 1,000 stores close
headlines.summary: The national pharmacy retail chain is making a push to win over customers that rivals have abandoned.

headlines.title: Alaska Airlines taps CVS Health exec for newly created tech role
headlines.summary: As the company's chief information technology officer, Amaresh Siva will lead enterprise tech and AI as the company looks for a return to profitability.

headlines.title: MinuteClinic® opens three new retail medical clinics to serve Massachusetts patients
headlines.summary: CVS Health® (NYSE: CVS) today announced that MinuteClinic®, the medical clinic inside select CVS Pharmacy® locations, has opened three new locations in Charlestown, Beverly and Swampscott, to help increase access to health care services for patients in those communities. The Charlestown clinic is the first MinuteClinic in the city of Boston, offering residents convenient, affordable and high-quality care.

description: CVS Health Corporation provides health solutions in the United States. The Health Care Benefits segment offers traditional, voluntary, and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including medical, pharmacy, dental, and behavioral health plans; medical management capabilities; Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans; prescription drug plans (PDPs); and Medicaid health care management services. It serves employer groups, individuals, college students, part-time and hourly workers, health plans, health care providers, governmental units, government-sponsored plans, labor groups, and expatriates. The Health Services segment offers pharmacy benefit management solutions, including plan design and administration, formulary management, retail pharmacy network management, specialty and mail-order pharmacy, clinical services, disease management, medical spend management services, and pharmacy and other administrative services. It serves employers, insurance companies, unions, government employee groups, health plans, PDPs, Medicaid managed care plans, CMS, plans offered on public health insurance exchanges, and other sponsors of health benefit plans. The Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment sells prescription and over-the-counter drugs, consumer health and beauty products, personal care products, and other general merchandise products. This segment also distributes prescription drugs; and provides related pharmacy consulting and other ancillary services to care facilities and other care settings. It operates online retail pharmacy websites, retail specialty pharmacy stores, and compounding pharmacies, as well as branches for infusion and enteral nutrition services. The company was formerly known as CVS Caremark Corporation and changed its name to CVS Health Corporation in September 2014. CVS Health Corporation was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Woonsocket, Rhode Island.
